channel.title: 2025 on The CTO Trap
channel.description: Recent content in 2025 on The CTO Trap

item.title: Building Quality When AI Writes Most of Your Code
item.description: AI accelerates output but not judgment. Quality must be engineered deliberately in an era where most code is machine-generated.

item.title: What Makes Software Good Has Changed
item.description: The definition of good software has split into two realities. Most leaders still haven’t realized it.

item.title: When Infrastructure Fails: The Leadership Accountability Gap
item.description: From AWS outages to Germany’s Telematikinfrastruktur, 2025 showed that resilience isn’t built in data centers — it’s enforced by leadership that understands complexity and owns interdependencies.

item.title: The micro-apps revolution: Can building software be too easy?
item.description: AI-created micro-apps are creating technical debt faster than ever, while eroding the very skills that make engineering teams valuable. How do CTOs shift from managing execution to managing decision quality at scale?

item.title: The Enforcement Trap: Why Pressuring Developers Guarantees Failure
item.description: It’s 2025, 12 years after “The Phoenix Project”. Yet, there are companies that seem to be unaware of product and development culture.
